Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. It does not provide the complete Causal admission and host"},{"line":23,"text":"lifecycle proof described below."},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"## Private Causal integration"},{"line":26,"text":""},{"line":27,"text":"Run from the repository root:"},{"line":28,"text":""},{"line":29,"text":"```sh"},{"line":30,"text":"node --import tsx examples/spending-alerts/causal-graded-demo.ts"},{"line":31,"text":"```"},{"line":32,"text":""},{"line":33,"text":"The output contains the complete graph plus a `composition` summary. It runs two"},{"line":34,"text":"instances, A and B, in the same Graph: A waits for its simulated result while the"},{"line":35,"text":"panel switches to B; B succeeds without settling A; A then completes while its"},{"line":36,"text":"panel is detached, and reconnecting does not write again. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":94,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":95,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":98,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":99,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":100,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":101,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":102,"text":""},{"line":103,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. It does not provide the complete Causal admission and host"},{"line":23,"text":"lifecycle proof described below."},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"## Private Causal integration"},{"line":26,"text":""},{"line":27,"text":"Run from the repository root:"},{"line":28,"text":""},{"line":29,"text":"```sh"},{"line":30,"text":"node --import tsx examples/spending-alerts/causal-graded-demo.ts"},{"line":31,"text":"```"},{"line":32,"text":""},{"line":33,"text":"The output contains the complete graph plus a `composition` summary. It runs two"},{"line":34,"text":"instances, A and B, in the same Graph: A waits for its simulated result while the"},{"line":35,"text":"panel switches to B; B succeeds without settling A; A then completes while its"},{"line":36,"text":"panel is detached, and reconnecting does not write again. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. It does not provide the complete Causal admission and host"},{"line":23,"text":"lifecycle proof described below."},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"## Private Causal integration"},{"line":26,"text":""},{"line":27,"text":"Run from the repository root:"},{"line":28,"text":""},{"line":29,"text":"```sh"},{"line":30,"text":"node --import tsx examples/spending-alerts/causal-graded-demo.ts"},{"line":31,"text":"```"},{"line":32,"text":""},{"line":33,"text":"The output contains the complete graph plus a `composition` summary. It runs two"},{"line":34,"text":"instances, A and B, in the same Graph: A waits for its simulated result while the"},{"line":35,"text":"panel switches to B; B succeeds without settling A; A then completes while its"},{"line":36,"text":"panel is detached, and reconnecting does not write again. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. The writer simulates completion in"},{"line":45,"text":"memory. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; no default approval |"},{"line":63,"text":"| inbox | The separately prepared `OfflineAlertResource` with its exact binding |"},{"line":64,"text":""},{"line":65,"text":"It then calls `spendingAlertsFor(graph, { name: \"alerts\" }).compose(inputs)`."},{"line":66,"text":"Configuration allocates no graph nodes; compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":69,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token."},{"line":70,"text":""},{"line":71,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":72,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":73,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":74,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":75,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":92,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":93,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":94,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":95,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":98,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":99,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":100,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":101,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":102,"text":""},{"line":103,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. The existing"},{"line":104,"text":"public `subscribeNodeValues` adapter currently ignores INVALIDATE, so it is not a"},{"line":105,"text":"direct substitute for this particular view contract."},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"## Inspect code changes and evidence"},{"line":108,"text":""},{"line":109,"text":"Follow the actual request, admission and outcome references in the demo output to"},{"line":110,"text":"the running graph. Then distinguish these three questions:"},{"line":111,"text":""},{"line":112,"text":"| Question | Evidence required |"},{"line":113,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":114,"text":"| Did this node's implementation change despite unchanged ID/edges? | Revision-bound source mapping within its declared coverage |"},{"line":115,"text":"| Who changed it? | Separate provenance; an implementation digest alone gives no attribution |"},{"line":116,"text":"| Which consequences remain unchanged? | Independent verification bound to the current revision and inputs |"},{"line":117,"text":""},{"line":118,"text":"Missing source binding means uncovered; missing provenance means unknown. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":94,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":95,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":98,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":99,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":100,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":101,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":102,"text":""},{"line":103,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":94,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":95,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":98,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":99,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":100,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":101,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":102,"text":""},{"line":103,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":94,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":95,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":98,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":99,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":100,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":101,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":102,"text":""},{"line":103,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. It does not provide the complete Causal admission and host"},{"line":23,"text":"lifecycle proof described below."},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"## Private Causal integration"},{"line":26,"text":""},{"line":27,"text":"Run from the repository root:"},{"line":28,"text":""},{"line":29,"text":"```sh"},{"line":30,"text":"node --import tsx examples/spending-alerts/causal-graded-demo.ts"},{"line":31,"text":"```"},{"line":32,"text":""},{"line":33,"text":"The output contains the complete graph plus a `composition` summary. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; no default approval |"},{"line":63,"text":"| inbox | The separately prepared `OfflineAlertResource` with its exact binding |"},{"line":64,"text":""},{"line":65,"text":"It then calls `spendingAlertsFor(graph, { name: \"alerts\" }).compose(inputs)`."},{"line":66,"text":"Configuration allocates no graph nodes; compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":69,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token."},{"line":70,"text":""},{"line":71,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":72,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":73,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":74,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":92,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":93,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":94,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":95,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":98,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":99,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":100,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":101,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":102,"text":""},{"line":103,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. An old"},{"line":119,"text":"receipt does not verify a new implementation. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; no default approval |"},{"line":63,"text":"| inbox | The separately prepared `OfflineAlertResource` with its exact binding |"},{"line":64,"text":""},{"line":65,"text":"It then calls `spendingAlertsFor(graph, { name: \"alerts\" }).compose(inputs)`."},{"line":66,"text":"Configuration allocates no graph nodes; compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. It does not provide the complete Causal admission and host"},{"line":23,"text":"lifecycle proof described below."},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"## Private Causal integration"},{"line":26,"text":""},{"line":27,"text":"Run from the repository root:"},{"line":28,"text":""},{"line":29,"text":"```sh"},{"line":30,"text":"node --import tsx examples/spending-alerts/causal-graded-demo.ts"},{"line":31,"text":"```"},{"line":32,"text":""},{"line":33,"text":"The output contains the complete graph plus a `composition` summary. It runs two"},{"line":34,"text":"instances, A and B, in the same Graph: A waits for its simulated result while the"},{"line":35,"text":"panel switches to B; B succeeds without settling A; A then completes while its"},{"line":36,"text":"panel is detached, and reconnecting does not write again. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records
per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted
write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or
automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or
proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application
must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery.
The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended.

Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. It does not provide the complete Causal admission and host"},{"line":23,"text":"lifecycle proof described below."},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"## Private Causal integration"},{"line":26,"text":""},{"line":27,"text":"Run from the repository root:"},{"line":28,"text":""},{"line":29,"text":"```sh"},{"line":30,"text":"node --import tsx examples/spending-alerts/causal-graded-demo.ts"},{"line":31,"text":"```"},{"line":32,"text":""},{"line":33,"text":"The output contains the complete graph plus a `composition` summary. It runs two"},{"line":34,"text":"instances, A and B, in the same Graph: A waits for its simulated result while the"},{"line":35,"text":"panel switches to B; B succeeds without settling A; A then completes while its"},{"line":36,"text":"panel is detached, and reconnecting does not write again. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":92,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":93,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":94,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":95,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":98,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":99,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":100,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. It does not provide the complete Causal admission and host"},{"line":23,"text":"lifecycle proof described below."},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"## Private Causal integration"},{"line":26,"text":""},{"line":27,"text":"Run from the repository root:"},{"line":28,"text":""},{"line":29,"text":"```sh"},{"line":30,"text":"node --import tsx examples/spending-alerts/causal-graded-demo.ts"},{"line":31,"text":"```"},{"line":32,"text":""},{"line":33,"text":"The output contains the complete graph plus a `composition` summary. It runs two"},{"line":34,"text":"instances, A and B, in the same Graph: A waits for its simulated result while the"},{"line":35,"text":"panel switches to B; B succeeds without settling A; A then completes while its"},{"line":36,"text":"panel is detached, and reconnecting does not write again. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. It does not provide the complete Causal admission and host"},{"line":23,"text":"lifecycle proof described below."},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"## Private Causal integration"},{"line":26,"text":""},{"line":27,"text":"Run from the repository root:"},{"line":28,"text":""},{"line":29,"text":"```sh"},{"line":30,"text":"node --import tsx examples/spending-alerts/causal-graded-demo.ts"},{"line":31,"text":"```"},{"line":32,"text":""},{"line":33,"text":"The output contains the complete graph plus a `composition` summary. It runs two"},{"line":34,"text":"instances, A and B, in the same Graph: A waits for its simulated result while the"},{"line":35,"text":"panel switches to B; B succeeds without settling A; A then completes while its"},{"line":36,"text":"panel is detached, and reconnecting does not write again. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. It does not provide the complete Causal admission and host"},{"line":23,"text":"lifecycle proof described below."},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"## Private Causal integration"},{"line":26,"text":""},{"line":27,"text":"Run from the repository root:"},{"line":28,"text":""},{"line":29,"text":"```sh"},{"line":30,"text":"node --import tsx examples/spending-alerts/causal-graded-demo.ts"},{"line":31,"text":"```"},{"line":32,"text":""},{"line":33,"text":"The output contains the complete graph plus a `composition` summary. It runs two"},{"line":34,"text":"instances, A and B, in the same Graph: A waits for its simulated result while the"},{"line":35,"text":"panel switches to B; B succeeds without settling A; A then completes while its"},{"line":36,"text":"panel is detached, and reconnecting does not write again. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":92,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":93,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":94,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":95,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":98,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":99,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":100,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. It does not provide the complete Causal admission and host"},{"line":23,"text":"lifecycle proof described below."},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"## Private Causal integration"},{"line":26,"text":""},{"line":27,"text":"Run from the repository root:"},{"line":28,"text":""},{"line":29,"text":"```sh"},{"line":30,"text":"node --import tsx examples/spending-alerts/causal-graded-demo.ts"},{"line":31,"text":"```"},{"line":32,"text":""},{"line":33,"text":"The output contains the complete graph plus a `composition` summary. It runs two"},{"line":34,"text":"instances, A and B, in the same Graph: A waits for its simulated result while the"},{"line":35,"text":"panel switches to B; B succeeds without settling A; A then completes while its"},{"line":36,"text":"panel is detached, and reconnecting does not write again. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. It does not provide the complete Causal admission and host"},{"line":23,"text":"lifecycle proof described below."},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"## Private Causal integration"},{"line":26,"text":""},{"line":27,"text":"Run from the repository root:"},{"line":28,"text":""},{"line":29,"text":"```sh"},{"line":30,"text":"node --import tsx examples/spending-alerts/causal-graded-demo.ts"},{"line":31,"text":"```"},{"line":32,"text":""},{"line":33,"text":"The output contains the complete graph plus a `composition` summary. It runs two"},{"line":34,"text":"instances, A and B, in the same Graph: A waits for its simulated result while the"},{"line":35,"text":"panel switches to B; B succeeds without settling A; A then completes while its"},{"line":36,"text":"panel is detached, and reconnecting does not write again. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. It does not provide the complete Causal admission and host"},{"line":23,"text":"lifecycle proof described below."},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"## Private Causal integration"},{"line":26,"text":""},{"line":27,"text":"Run from the repository root:"},{"line":28,"text":""},{"line":29,"text":"```sh"},{"line":30,"text":"node --import tsx examples/spending-alerts/causal-graded-demo.ts"},{"line":31,"text":"```"},{"line":32,"text":""},{"line":33,"text":"The output contains the complete graph plus a `composition` summary. It runs two"},{"line":34,"text":"instances, A and B, in the same Graph: A waits for its simulated result while the"},{"line":35,"text":"panel switches to B; B succeeds without settling A; A then completes while its"},{"line":36,"text":"panel is detached, and reconnecting does not write again. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. It does not provide the complete Causal admission and host"},{"line":23,"text":"lifecycle proof described below."},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"## Private Causal integration"},{"line":26,"text":""},{"line":27,"text":"Run from the repository root:"},{"line":28,"text":""},{"line":29,"text":"```sh"},{"line":30,"text":"node --import tsx examples/spending-alerts/causal-graded-demo.ts"},{"line":31,"text":"```"},{"line":32,"text":""},{"line":33,"text":"The output contains the complete graph plus a `composition` summary. It runs two"},{"line":34,"text":"instances, A and B, in the same Graph: A waits for its simulated result while the"},{"line":35,"text":"panel switches to B; B succeeds without settling A; A then completes while its"},{"line":36,"text":"panel is detached, and reconnecting does not write again. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service.
