The private Causal"},{"line":5,"text":"integration demonstrates admission, retained obligations and graded consumption"},{"line":6,"text":"with an **offline simulated writer**. Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. It does not provide the complete Causal admission and host"},{"line":23,"text":"lifecycle proof described below."},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"## Private Causal integration"},{"line":26,"text":""},{"line":27,"text":"Run from the repository root:"},{"line":28,"text":""},{"line":29,"text":"```sh"},{"line":30,"text":"node --import tsx examples/spending-alerts/causal-graded-demo.ts"},{"line":31,"text":"```"},{"line":32,"text":""},{"line":33,"text":"The output contains the complete graph plus a `composition` summary. It runs two"},{"line":34,"text":"instances, A and B, in the same Graph: A waits for its simulated result while the"},{"line":35,"text":"panel switches to B; B succeeds without settling A; A then completes while its"},{"line":36,"text":"panel is detached, and reconnecting does not write again. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. The writer simulates completion in"},{"line":45,"text":"memory. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; no default approval |"},{"line":63,"text":"| inbox | The separately prepared `OfflineAlertResource` with its exact binding |"},{"line":64,"text":""},{"line":65,"text":"It then calls `spendingAlertsFor(graph, { name: \"alerts\" }).compose(inputs)`."},{"line":66,"text":"Configuration allocates no graph nodes; compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":69,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token."},{"line":70,"text":""},{"line":71,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":72,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":73,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":74,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":75,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":76,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":77,"text":""},{"line":78,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":79,"text":""},{"line":80,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"}],"nextLine":81},{"ok":true,"path":"examples/spending-alerts/causal-entry.ts","sha256":"3d802f8b01c27519dbcc7b0ed77ed151bc8fa4fd2e0337b7535879e3dbf9b792","totalLines":78,"startLine":1,"endLine":78,"lines":[{"line":1,"text":"/** Consumer-private graded entry. The application"},{"line":95,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":98,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":99,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":100,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":101,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":102,"text":""},{"line":103,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. It runs two"},{"line":34,"text":"instances, A and B, in the same Graph: A waits for its simulated result while the"},{"line":35,"text":"panel switches to B; B succeeds without settling A; A then completes while its"},{"line":36,"text":"panel is detached, and reconnecting does not write again. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; no default approval |"},{"line":63,"text":"| inbox | The separately prepared `OfflineAlertResource` with its exact binding |"},{"line":64,"text":""},{"line":65,"text":"It then calls `spendingAlertsFor(graph, { name: \"alerts\" }).compose(inputs)`."},{"line":66,"text":"Configuration allocates no graph nodes; compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. A name is not an authorization token."},{"line":70,"text":""},{"line":71,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":72,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":73,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":74,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":75,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":76,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":77,"text":""},{"line":78,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":79,"text":""},{"line":80,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"}],"nextLine":81},{"ok":true,"path":"examples/spending-alerts/causal-entry.ts","sha256":"3d802f8b01c27519dbcc7b0ed77ed151bc8fa4fd2e0337b7535879e3dbf9b792","totalLines":78,"startLine":1,"endLine":78,"lines":[{"line":1,"text":"/** Consumer-private graded entry. The private Causal"},{"line":5,"text":"integration demonstrates admission, retained obligations and graded consumption"},{"line":6,"text":"with an **offline simulated writer**. Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. It does not provide the complete Causal admission and host"},{"line":23,"text":"lifecycle proof described below."},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"## Private Causal integration"},{"line":26,"text":""},{"line":27,"text":"Run from the repository root:"},{"line":28,"text":""},{"line":29,"text":"```sh"},{"line":30,"text":"node --import tsx examples/spending-alerts/causal-graded-demo.ts"},{"line":31,"text":"```"},{"line":32,"text":""},{"line":33,"text":"The output contains the complete graph plus a `composition` summary. It runs two"},{"line":34,"text":"instances, A and B, in the same Graph: A waits for its simulated result while the"},{"line":35,"text":"panel switches to B; B succeeds without settling A; A then completes while its"},{"line":36,"text":"panel is detached, and reconnecting does not write again. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. The writer simulates completion in"},{"line":45,"text":"memory. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; no default approval |"},{"line":63,"text":"| inbox | The separately prepared `OfflineAlertResource` with its exact binding |"},{"line":64,"text":""},{"line":65,"text":"It then calls `spendingAlertsFor(graph, { name: \"alerts\" }).compose(inputs)`."},{"line":66,"text":"Configuration allocates no graph nodes; compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":69,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token."},{"line":70,"text":""},{"line":71,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":72,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":73,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":74,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":75,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":76,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":77,"text":""},{"line":78,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":79,"text":""},{"line":80,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"}],"nextLine":81},{"ok":true,"path":"examples/spending-alerts/causal-entry.ts","sha256":"3d802f8b01c27519dbcc7b0ed77ed151bc8fa4fd2e0337b7535879e3dbf9b792","totalLines":78,"startLine":1,"endLine":78,"lines":[{"line":1,"text":"/** Consumer-private graded entry. The application"},{"line":95,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":98,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":99,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":100,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":101,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":102,"text":""},{"line":103,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; The original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":4,"text":"explains how an anomalous transaction produces an alert message. The private Causal"},{"line":5,"text":"integration demonstrates admission, retained obligations and graded consumption"},{"line":6,"text":"with an **offline simulated writer**. Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. It does not provide the complete Causal admission and host"},{"line":23,"text":"lifecycle proof described below."},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"## Private Causal integration"},{"line":26,"text":""},{"line":27,"text":"Run from the repository root:"},{"line":28,"text":""},{"line":29,"text":"```sh"},{"line":30,"text":"node --import tsx examples/spending-alerts/causal-graded-demo.ts"},{"line":31,"text":"```"},{"line":32,"text":""},{"line":33,"text":"The output contains the complete graph plus a `composition` summary. It runs two"},{"line":34,"text":"instances, A and B, in the same Graph: A waits for its simulated result while the"},{"line":35,"text":"panel switches to B; B succeeds without settling A; A then completes while its"},{"line":36,"text":"panel is detached, and reconnecting does not write again. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. The writer simulates completion in"},{"line":45,"text":"memory. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; no default approval |"},{"line":63,"text":"| inbox | The separately prepared `OfflineAlertResource` with its exact binding |"},{"line":64,"text":""},{"line":65,"text":"It then calls `spendingAlertsFor(graph, { name: \"alerts\" }).compose(inputs)`."},{"line":66,"text":"Configuration allocates no graph nodes; compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":69,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token."},{"line":70,"text":""},{"line":71,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":72,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":73,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":74,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":75,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":76,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":77,"text":""},{"line":78,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":79,"text":""},{"line":80,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"}],"nextLine":81},{"ok":true,"path":"examples/spending-alerts/causal-entry.ts","sha256":"3d802f8b01c27519dbcc7b0ed77ed151bc8fa4fd2e0337b7535879e3dbf9b792","totalLines":78,"startLine":1,"endLine":78,"lines":[{"line":1,"text":"/** Consumer-private graded entry. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; The original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":4,"text":"explains how an anomalous transaction produces an alert message. The private Causal"},{"line":5,"text":"integration demonstrates admission, retained obligations and graded consumption"},{"line":6,"text":"with an **offline simulated writer**. Neither command writes a real inbox."},{"line":7,"text":""},{"line":8,"text":"## Original five-hop pipeline"},{"line":9,"text":""},{"line":10,"text":"```sh"},{"line":11,"text":"pnpm --filter @graphrefly-examples/spending-alerts start"},{"line":12,"text":"```"},{"line":13,"text":""},{"line":14,"text":"```text"},{"line":15,"text":"txFeed → anomalyScore → thresholdGate → reasonFactors → alertMessage"},{"line":16,"text":"             ↑"},{"line":17,"text":"      vendorStats + userProfile"},{"line":18,"text":"```"},{"line":19,"text":""},{"line":20,"text":"The original [pipeline](pipeline.ts) uses"},{"line":21,"text":"`graph.describe({ explain: { from: \"txFeed\", to: \"alertMessage\" } })` to explain"},{"line":22,"text":"its dependency chain. It does not provide the complete Causal admission and host"},{"line":23,"text":"lifecycle proof described below."},{"line":24,"text":""},{"line":25,"text":"## Private Causal integration"},{"line":26,"text":""},{"line":27,"text":"Run from the repository root:"},{"line":28,"text":""},{"line":29,"text":"```sh"},{"line":30,"text":"node --import tsx examples/spending-alerts/causal-graded-demo.ts"},{"line":31,"text":"```"},{"line":32,"text":""},{"line":33,"text":"The output contains the complete graph plus a `composition` summary. It runs two"},{"line":34,"text":"instances, A and B, in the same Graph: A waits for its simulated result while the"},{"line":35,"text":"panel switches to B; B succeeds without settling A; A then completes while its"},{"line":36,"text":"panel is detached, and reconnecting does not write again. Expect"},{"line":37,"text":"`aPendingAfterB: 1`, `bSucceededWhileAPending: \"succeeded\"` and"},{"line":38,"text":"`writes: { \"a\": 1, \"b\": 1 }`. `evidenceNavigation` connects each actual publication"},{"line":39,"text":"to its request, admission, outcome and fixture verification reference. These are"},{"line":40,"text":"executed assertions, not a human usability experiment."},{"line":41,"text":""},{"line":42,"text":"These are consumer-private source imports, **not published package subpaths**."},{"line":43,"text":"The fixture oracle supplies independent expected results for this finite example;"},{"line":44,"text":"it is not a production verification service. The writer simulates completion in"},{"line":45,"text":"memory. Input messages in the demo are test-boundary facts, not new public"},{"line":46,"text":"feed/publish/approve methods."},{"line":47,"text":""},{"line":48,"text":"Choose a reading path:"},{"line":49,"text":""},{"line":50,"text":"| Your task | Start here | What remains with the application |"},{"line":51,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":52,"text":"| Display business values | [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts), then [value binding](causal-view-binding.ts) | Construction, input sources, permissions, resource and running owner |"},{"line":53,"text":"| Integrate or compose components | [complete application demo](causal-graded-demo.ts), then [creation entry](causal-entry.ts) and [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) | Verification and permission provenance, original capabilities, lifecycle ownership |"},{"line":54,"text":"| Understand the executing system | The demo's actual graph and request records, then [host](causal-focused-host.ts) and [authority construction](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/construction.ts) | Interpreting exact source, admission, outcome and evidence bindings |"},{"line":55,"text":""},{"line":56,"text":"The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:"},{"line":57,"text":""},{"line":58,"text":"| Input group | Explicit source responsibility |"},{"line":59,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":60,"text":"| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |"},{"line":61,"text":"| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |"},{"line":62,"text":"| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; no default approval |"},{"line":63,"text":"| inbox | The separately prepared `OfflineAlertResource` with its exact binding |"},{"line":64,"text":""},{"line":65,"text":"It then calls `spendingAlertsFor(graph, { name: \"alerts\" }).compose(inputs)`."},{"line":66,"text":"Configuration allocates no graph nodes; compose creates a complete runtime."},{"line":67,"text":"Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only"},{"line":68,"text":"select name/diagnostics. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":69,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token."},{"line":70,"text":""},{"line":71,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":72,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":73,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":74,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":75,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":76,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":77,"text":""},{"line":78,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":79,"text":""},{"line":80,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"}],"nextLine":81},{"ok":true,"path":"examples/spending-alerts/causal-entry.ts","sha256":"3d802f8b01c27519dbcc7b0ed77ed151bc8fa4fd2e0337b7535879e3dbf9b792","totalLines":78,"startLine":1,"endLine":78,"lines":[{"line":1,"text":"/** Consumer-private graded entry.
